$comment: Envelopes are DATA, not code (REQUIREMENTS.md §5). Adding one means writing down what a standard publishes — its limits — and nothing else. The polygon is computed by the engine at the document's own altitude, because a relative-humidity bound is a curve whose shape depends on barometric pressure. Bounds are in SI and are omitted when the standard does not state them; `null` means unbounded, not zero.

envelopes.name: TC 9.9 Recommended
envelopes.source: ASHRAE TC 9.9, Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments
envelopes.rationale: The upper dew-point bound guards against condensation on cold heat sinks and against corrosion and conductive anodic filament growth; the lower bound guards against electrostatic discharge. The band is far taller than a comfort zone because its floor is a −9 °C dew point, not a comfort humidity.

envelopes.name: TC 9.9 Allowable A1
envelopes.source: ASHRAE TC 9.9, Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments
envelopes.rationale: Enterprise servers and storage. Allowable means the equipment is warranted to operate here, not that it should be run here continuously.

envelopes.name: TC 9.9 Allowable A2
envelopes.source: ASHRAE TC 9.9, Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments
envelopes.rationale: Volume servers, storage and networking equipment.

envelopes.name: TC 9.9 Allowable A3
envelopes.source: ASHRAE TC 9.9, Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments
envelopes.rationale: Equipment specified for wider environmental ranges, which is what makes economiser hours available in more climates.

envelopes.name: TC 9.9 Allowable A4
envelopes.source: ASHRAE TC 9.9, Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments
envelopes.rationale: The widest class, intended for facilities running chiller-less on outdoor air for most of the year.

envelopes.name: Std 55 comfort — summer
envelopes.source: ASHRAE Standard 55, graphic comfort zone method
envelopes.rationale: 0.5 clo clothing, sedentary activity, still air. The upper humidity bound is a humidity ratio rather than a relative humidity: the standard limits absolute moisture, because that is what governs skin wettedness.

envelopes.name: Std 55 comfort — winter
envelopes.source: ASHRAE Standard 55, graphic comfort zone method
envelopes.rationale: 1.0 clo clothing, sedentary activity, still air. Cooler than the summer zone by about two kelvin, for the same reason people wear more indoors in winter.
